verdict_vocabulary.COMPLETE: stage infrastructure and planned scope delivered
verdict_vocabulary.FROZEN: stage record immutable; changes require a new preregistration
verdict_vocabulary.REJECTED: preregistered hypothesis failed its declared evidence bar
verdict_vocabulary.FALSIFIED: evidence contradicts the preregistered hypothesis under the declared experiment
verdict_vocabulary.INCONCLUSIVE: experiment did not generate sufficient evidence to decide the hypothesis; never read as a pass
verdict_vocabulary.PARKED: further work under the current data/assumption class not justified; reopening requires a material change (new data class or new preregistered rationale)
verdict_vocabulary.BLOCKED_DATA: required data class does not exist; synthetic proxies banned
verdict_vocabulary.DEFERRED: prerequisite (an additional validated strategy family) does not exist

stages.name: infrastructure_verification
stages.outcome_summary: existing contracts verified; only real gap (trade-stream persistence) patched as R1-A

stages.name: monte_carlo_diagnostics
stages.outcome_summary: resampling ladder on TS-R4-D1-0001 (1,311 trades); IID resampling understates drawdown/streak/recovery tails vs dependence-aware block resampling; diagnostics, not forecasts

stages.name: factor_laboratory
stages.outcome_summary: lab validated; momentum_12_1 x r4_local_v1 x h=21: mean rank IC -0.0440, Holm p 0.4398, stress-cost spread negative; one slot consumed

stages.name: parameter_stability
stages.outcome_summary: frozen config OUTSIDE_STABLE_REGION on 1,500-point preregistered grid (92% fragile, PBO 1.000 across 16/16 partitions with non-independence caveat, DSR 0.0019 n.s.); observed axis associations quarantined from action

stages.name: mean_reversion_stat_arb
stages.outcome_summary: gate starvation structural on daily bars (0-3 active regimes per ~87 estimation dates; 5 trades across 8 preregistered pairs); reopening requires a new data class

stages.name: triple_barrier_labeling
stages.outcome_summary: labeling instrument validated (1,311 events = TS-R4-D1-0001, 0 exclusions, byte-identical determinism, PIT proven by perturbation); overlap characterized (492 pairs, 663 events, mean uniqueness 0.837); NOT evidence of predictive power

stages.name: meta_labeling
verdict_sequence: R6-B1 INCONCLUSIVE (preregistered filter vacuous: skip class empty)
stages.outcome_summary: B1 design exercised end-to-end with all pre-execution checks passing; R4's upstream regime gate had already excluded the filter's targeted states; B2 correctly not run; supported claim is filter-specific, NOT 'no feature can work'

stages.name: order_flow_entropy
stages.outcome_summary: requires trade/order-flow data with aggressor_side; see docs/research/DATA_REQUIREMENTS.md section 2

stages.name: strategy_level_portfolio
stages.outcome_summary: requires at least one additional validated strategy family; none exists

production_boundary.rule: nothing in R0-R6 constitutes permission to alter frozen R4; any future change enters as a new preregistered research program with a fresh trial ledger

reopening_rules: new research starts with a NEW preregistration and fresh trial accounting; never by extending R2-R6
parked stages reopen only via a materially different preregistered rationale or a new data class (see docs/research/DATA_REQUIREMENTS.md)
R8 requires at least one additional validated strategy family
queue closure means the currently justified program is exhausted without manufacturing evidence, not that research is finished
